question: Should OpenClaw core permanently reserve the top-level `auth` command root despite the plugin CLI contract allowing plugins to own root command groups?
rationale: The existing command already solves profile inspection, so accepting this shortcut is a product namespace decision with plugin-upgrade consequences rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep the root plugin-compatible
options.body: Do not merge the alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the supported profile-listing surface.

options.title: Reserve `auth` for core
options.body: Sponsor the new root only with explicit collision semantics, upgrade tests, documentation, and real behavior proof covering an installed plugin that declares `auth`.

recommendation.title: Keep the root plugin-compatible
recommendation.body: Do not merge the alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the supported profile-listing surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history signal for the plugin CLI descriptor and root-registration contract affected by the decision.
